summary: Kanabec County, Minnesota tower: a 100-foot Aermotor tower was erected in 1955. The FFLA list marks it gone, and a visitor's log describes only the former site.

facts.status_note: The FFLA list marks it gone. The only site description is a visitor's log describing the former tower site.

events.note: 100-foot Aermotor tower erected, per the Central US Lookouts Minnesota list; no builder named

evidence.supports: listed as Woodland, Kanabec County, marked gone
the place is the site of the former tower
evidence.quote: the site of the former tower

evidence.supports: a cluster of radio antennae at first misled the visitor
evidence.quote: at first a cluster of radio antennae misled me

evidence.supports: a GPS receiver led around a corner to the former tower site

notes_for_editor: Three sources, none detailed. Built year and height come only from the Central US Lookouts list; the 100-foot figure may be total height rather than height to the cab floor. Status 'gone' is from FFLA; removal date not found. kjackson.us is a hobbyist site; its visit log is undated. It has a Flickr photo of the site (cageyj, licence not shown), not added to the record because no licence was visible. No builder, staffing, or fire history found. Did not check the township reference against the coordinates.
